description: This file defines the PHP interface JsonApiResponseInterface within the SuiteCRM JSON API v1 namespace. It declares a single method toJsonApiResponse(), which is intended to return an array representing a JSON API response.

classes.name: JsonApiResponseInterface
classes.description: A PHP interface that requires implementation of a method toJsonApiResponse(), used for converting objects into a JSON API response array.

methods.name: toJsonApiResponse
methods.description: Returns an array representing the JSON API response.
